actions.addTagToUser.description: Adds a tag to a user and returns the updated user.
The ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID. Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.
actions.createSubscriber.description: Creates a Unified or a Whatsapp subscriber.
actions.createSubscriber.props.consent_p: The consent phrase provided by the subscriber.
actions.createSubscriber.props.email.des: Fill in at least one field: phone or email or whatsapp phone.
actions.createSubscriber.props.phone.des: Fill in at least one field: phone or email or whatsapp phone.
actions.createSubscriber.props.whatsapp_: Fill in at least one field: phone or email or whatsapp phone.
actions.create_custom_field.description: Creates a new subscriber custom field in the ManyChat account.
actions.create_tag.description: Creates a new tag in the ManyChat account.
actions.findUserByCustomField.descriptio: Finds users whose text or number custom field equals a value. ManyChat returns at most 100 matches.
actions.findUserByName.description: Finds users by full name. ManyChat returns at most 100 matches.
actions.findUserByName.props.name.descri: Provide user's full name to search.
actions.find_subscriber_by_email_or_phon: Finds the subscriber with a given email address (case-insensitive) or exact phone number.
Find Subscriber by Email or Phone
Full email address, matched case-insensitively. Provide this OR Phone, not both.
Exact phone number in international format, for example +14155550123. Provide this OR Email, not both.
actions.get_page_info.description: Gets the connected ManyChat account (page) details.
actions.get_subscriber.description: Gets a subscriber by ID, with their tags and custom field values.
actions.get_subscriber.props.subscriber_: The numeric ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID, for example from "Find Subscriber by Email or Phone" or a contact profile.
actions.list_custom_fields.description: Lists every subscriber custom field in the ManyChat account.
actions.list_custom_fields.props.type.de: Only fields of this type: text, number, date, datetime, boolean, array. Leave empty for all.
actions.list_flows.description: Lists every flow and flow folder in the ManyChat account.
actions.list_tags.description: Lists every tag in the ManyChat account.
actions.list_tags.props.name_contains.de: Only tags whose name contains this text (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.
actions.removeTagFromUser.description: Removes a tag from a user and returns the updated user.
actions.removeTagFromUser.props.subscrib: The ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID. Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.
actions.sendContentToUser.description: Sends a text or media message to a user. Messenger only delivers outside the 24-hour window when a Message Tag is set.
actions.sendContentToUser.props.content_: The type of content to send.
actions.sendContentToUser.props.media_ur: URL of the media to send (image, video, audio, or file). Required for media content types.
actions.sendContentToUser.props.message_: Messenger message tag that allows sending outside the 24-hour window. Instagram and WhatsApp ignore it. Meta no longer accepts Business Productivity; it is kept only for existing flows.
actions.sendContentToUser.props.platform: The platform to send the content to.
actions.sendContentToUser.props.subscrib: The ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID. Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.
actions.sendContentToUser.props.text_con: The text content to send. Required when content type is Text.
actions.send_flow.description: Starts a ManyChat flow for a subscriber. The subscriber must be inside the messaging window, and ManyChat allows at most 100 flow sends per subscriber per hour. The flow must be published in ManyChat; drafts appear in the list but can't be sent.
actions.send_flow.props.flow_ns.descript: The flow to start. Its namespace (ns) is sent to ManyChat. The flow must be published in ManyChat; drafts appear in the list but can't be sent.
actions.send_flow.props.subscriber_id.de: The numeric ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID, for example from "Find Subscriber by Email or Phone" or a contact profile.
actions.setCustomField.description: Adds or updates a custom field value for a user and returns the updated user. ManyChat returns date-time values in the account timezone (same moment, so the day may differ).
actions.setCustomField.props.subscriber_: The ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID. Please refer [Manychat Guide](https://help.manychat.com/hc/en-us/articles/14959510331420-How-to-generate-a-token-for-the-Manychat-API-and-where-to-get-parameters#h_01JCR55RJ0B0PQW6HDW6RW0A42) to obtain user/contact ID.
actions.set_subscriber_custom_fields.des: Sets 1 to 20 custom field values on a subscriber in one call.
actions.set_subscriber_custom_fields.pro: Up to 20 items. Field is a custom field ID or exact name; Value is the new value.
The numeric ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID, for example from "Find Subscriber by Email or Phone" or a contact profile.
actions.update_subscriber.description: Updates the name, phone, email, gender or opt-ins of a subscriber. Empty fields are left unchanged.
actions.update_subscriber.props.consent_: The consent phrase the subscriber accepted. Required when SMS Opt-in is Yes.
actions.update_subscriber.props.email.de: Requires Email Opt-in. Choosing No stores the address without opting in. An address cannot be removed through the API.
actions.update_subscriber.props.has_opt_: Whether the subscriber agreed to receive email. Required when Email is set. Leave empty to keep the current value.
Whether the subscriber agreed to receive SMS. Required when Phone is set. Leave empty to keep the current value.
actions.update_subscriber.props.phone.de: International format, for example +14155550123. Requires SMS Opt-in.
actions.update_subscriber.props.subscrib: The numeric ManyChat subscriber (contact) ID, for example from "Find Subscriber by Email or Phone" or a contact profile.
auth.description:
The ManyChat API needs a **Pro** plan. To get your API key:
1. Sign in to ManyChat and open the account you want to automate.
2. Go to **Settings -> API** and click **Generate your token**.
3. Copy the token. It looks like `<page_id>:<hash>`. Generating a new token revokes the old one.
